items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: But that was a great little band. It was J. J., Joe Newman, Sir Charles, Al Lucas, Shadow Wilson, and the baritone player Leo... Well, Shadow Wilson was in the band and Billy Taylor was in the band.

ctx.x: I don't know, I really don't know because we were all the time high. You know. But any way we would -- actually what we did was create jobs for musicians. Now, the premise behind the whole thing was for us to get to the star rather than to the agent, so I knew everybody in show business. Okay. So we would book this thing on Sundays, you know, like a little concert on Sundays, and on any Sunday I might have Art Tatum, Errol with his group, Bird with his group. Because they wouldn't charge me -- I'm not going…

And it was just a beautiful thing. We never made any money, we lost money really because all the musicians thought that they were the stars and they were drawing and that we were cheating them. Miles at this time, Miles was heavy
